name: Can a Garage Conversion Become a Full ADU?

mainEntity.name: Can a garage conversion ADU still include a full custom kitchen and bathroom in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: Can a garage conversion ADU still include a full custom kitchen and bathroom in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage conversion can often become a fully functional ADU with a custom kitchen and bathroom, but the existing structure must support the required living standards. Key factors include floor elevation, ceiling height, natural light, insulation, fire separation, waterproofing, and the ability to run plumbing and electrical systems efficiently. If the garage slab, framing, or access points are not suitable, the contractor may need to modify the structure before finish work begins. Kitchen and bath placement should be coordinated early because drain lines, venting, and vent hood requirements can affect the whole layout. A well-planned conversion can be one of the most cost-effective ways to add living space, but it should not be treated like a simple cosmetic remodel. Homeowners should ask for a feasibility review before investing in full drawings or finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a garage conversion ADU can usually include a full kitchen and bathroom if the space is designed to meet applicable building, plumbing, electrical, ventilation, and habitability requirements. The main challenges are ceiling height, insulation, drainage, and utility routing. Whether the layout works depends on the existing garage conditions and local code compliance.
